To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

preconception and post-conception use of TDF-(3 TC/FTC)-efavirrenz was not associated with preterm delivery or small for gestational age births compared with other antiretrovial regimens in a large, rural cohort of HIV-infected pregnant South African women.

pre-conception and post-conception use of tenofovir-based regimens was not associated with pre-term delivery or small-for-gestations-age births in a cohort of HIV-positive pregnant women in rural South Africa.

Increasingly more HIV-infected pregnant and postpartum women conceive or deliver while on antiretrovirals, and this study assessed the effect on birth outcomes of preconception or post-conception exposure to tenofovir-based regimens versus other regimens.

the impact of antiretrovials on pregnancy outcome and we found that preconception and post conception use of TDF based regimens did not have an impact on pregnancy outcome.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of TDF-3TC/FTc-EFV in the preconception and post-conception periods is not associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and/or small for gestational age births.
there are no differences in the rates of preterm delivery or low birth weight among the various antiretrovials used in the treatment of HIV.
preconception and post conception use of TDF-3TC/FTc-EFV was not associated with PPT and SGA compared to other regimens.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of TDF-(3Tc/FTC)-Efavirenz in the preconception and post-conception period was not associated with an increase risk of preterm delivery and small for gestational age births.
preconception and post-conception regimens containing TDF-(3Tc/FTC) and EFV are safe for pregnancy and do not appear to increase the risk for preterm delivery and small for gestational age births.

The main takeaway from our work is that

there is no association between preconception or post-conception use of TDF-3TC/FTCV-EFV versus other ART regimens and preterm delivery or small-for-gestional-age births in a large cohort of HIV-infected pregnant South African women.
pre-conception TDF-containing regimens and post-conception regimens are not associated with PPD or SGA.
there is no association of PTD and SGA births with the use of TDF-(3-TC/FTC)–EFV in pregnancy.
